decisions.statement: The rename is left to the mechanical change renaming many pages.
Each line of the argument names a page and the slug that page becomes.
A line that is not a path and a slug parted by a space is refused.
A line with nothing on it is read over.
The kind of page is read from the path rather than from the index.
A page type is refused here and the refusal names the change renaming one.
That change is reached through the runner rather than by an import.
Nothing here works out a body of its own.

definition: many pages renamed and carried to where their slugs say, in one call
